answer: Exactly the A/B/C question in Open Ambiguities; the plan (inventory:211) confirms the task is blocked only by this owner call. Steps 3-4 and 'Every closing entry point' depend on it.

Dependency task-rw-f3-atoms-service is status: deferred (desk/drawer/tasks/task-rw-f3-atoms-service.md:3), so unmet. Per inventory:211 the blocked state is the open advance decision; the owner unblocks it.
'Both routes' = the two closeout commit routes, --run-dir and --no-run, per Goal ('closeout commit (both routes)') and closeout.py:42-51 (_commit_with_run:117/_commit_manual:66). Not advance.
Automated route trailers are Task-Id, Run-Dir, plus optional Run-Id and Session-Sha256 (closeout.py:170-174). Manual route: Task-Id, Closeout-Mode: manual, Closeout-Reason (closeout.py:82).

closeout_gates planned at deskops/services/closeout_gates.py (task-rw-f3-closeout-gates-service.md:11); doc_io at deskops/doc_io.py (task-rw-f2-transactional-doc-io.md:11). Neither exists yet (ls deskops: no services/, no doc_io.py).

Scope fixes the --run-dir/--no-run CLI contract, so 'CLI unchanged' = flags, not behavior; Goal deliberately adds Board update + bundle removal. test_closeout.py has no task/Board, so the service must no-op when absent.
Both the advance exit code and its A/B/C behavior are the open owner decision; the plan leaves them to the owner.
'Names one entry point' matches recommended option A; under B or C the Done When would need rewording. This is the same open owner decision, not a separate defect.

The e2e test already isolates: _make_repo(tmp_path) builds a throwaway git repo (test_lifecycle_end_to_end.py:38-46). No real desk/ is touched; AGENTS.md's sandbox rule covers manual CLI exploration, not pytest.

Only the terminal closure (status closed / current_node complete) routes through closure.py; non-closeout advancement keeps routine.advance + _write_doc (operations.py:1045-1064). Scope rewires closure only.
Existing tests already assert this: last index line (test_closeout.py:127-130) and HEAD message/commit (test_lifecycle_end_to_end.py:178-186); counts are assertable the same way.
